evidence.record_quote: The Database of AI Litigation presents information about ongoing and completed litigation involving artificial intelligence and related topics.

atoms.reference: Cases from complaint forward, whether or not they generate published decisions, from algorithms in hiring, credit and sentencing to generative AI training and AI companion liability; a companion database of issued opinions; still under development.

evidence.record_quote: It covers cases from complaint forward - as soon as we learn of them - whether or not they generate published decisions.
It is intended to be broad in scope, covering everything from algorithms used in hiring and credit and criminal sentencing decisions to generative AI training and AI companion liability.
A companion database of issued opinions is available here .
While still under development, it will continue to expand over time.
